corrections.title: Manufacturer retail basis
corrections.detail: Suggested-retail/list programs now preserve the source MSRP components. Dealer schedules affect protected cost only; the universal cost-times-2.5 customer calculation was removed.

corrections.title: Dealer-only catalogs
corrections.detail: Lotus no longer invents customer retail and returns CUSTOMER_RETAIL_UNDEFINED. Onyx remains fail-closed before customer pricing because current restriction evidence is incomplete; its source-backed dealer cost remains authorization-protected.

corrections.title: Price components
corrections.detail: Base grid, fabric delta, accessories, and operating-system charges reconcile independently and sum to the exact customer total.

corrections.title: Polar standalone grids
corrections.detail: Drapery and awning programs are explicitly standalone grids instead of being misread as price-group upgrades.

corrections.title: Stored-price migration
corrections.detail: The MSRP policy uses new catalog identities; snapshots from the prior markup policy are stale even when their selection fingerprint is unchanged.

corrections.title: Dealer-only option ledger
corrections.detail: Onyx H2/H3 and Polar All Seasons option costs are itemized; incomplete or unproven dealer-cost options fail closed.

corrections.title: Source integrity
corrections.detail: The Polar generator accepts only the pinned SHA-256 and structural anchors, validates catalog inventory, and writes atomically.

corrections.title: Customer data boundary
corrections.detail: Customer failure projections use neutral wording and exclude dealer-net, margin, schedule, freight-cost, and landed-cost diagnostics.
